title: The publication owner can't add the DDL audit table to the publication: the admin owns it

found.by: DDL matrix: PostgreSQL standard CDC reruns with and without DDL support objects

symptom: ALTER PUBLICATION ... ADD TABLE on the DDL audit table, run as the publication owner, fails with 'must be owner of table'
cause: The audit table was created by the admin who ran the support objects script as superuser, so the table is owned by that admin
effect: The documented step fails for the publication owner, and the audit table is not in the publication until a superuser adds it
fix: Run the ADD TABLE as a superuser (this run did). Creating the audit objects as the publication owner was not tested
